scope: CPU reconstruction and shared-writer implementation regression; no public NoSlip or physical acceptance
source_change: JSphCpu.cpp reuses fitted gradients through the internal MLS callback. NoSlip uses the existing slip selector, full negative mirror derivative velocity, legacy tangent projection and unflipped stress extrapolated to the boundary. J/p head, geometric C and Darcy Ace policies are retained.

shared_writer_regression.scope: Wendland axis-aligned 2D/3D Vel0, NoSlip and FreeSlip; actual SPR, scalar pore writer and stress/pressure/density consumers

execution: One compile/link per helper and one execution per declared condition; closed process exits and consumed size/mtime bindings passed. No SHA scans, old worker restart, solver trajectory, new half-step chain or canonical executable installation.
next: GPU counterpart and actual wall-force/SH feedback checks, then corner/inactive/weak-top support before mixed-wall gravity admission.
